summary: This clinical trial compares how two different diabetes drugs affect liver fat content in people with type 2 diabetes and fatty liver disease. Participants are adults aged 18 to 70 who receive either the combination drug iGlarLixi or the drug iGlar alone. The study measures changes in the amount of fat stored in the liver over a 12-week treatment period. NCT07274644 is the identification number for this research study.
